map.通过一系列关于动机、恐惧与欲望的陈述，帮你定位九型人格（1~9 型）中的核心类型: Through a series of statements about motivation, fear and desire, it helps locate your core Enneagram type (1-9) and wings, understanding the driving force behind your behavior. Results are for self-growth reference.
map.给出主导型与可能侧翼: Give dominant type and possible wings
map.结果可保存复测: Results can be saved and retested
map.团队/关系：理解差异与摩擦源: Team/relationships: understand differences and friction sources
map.个人成长：针对性突破卡点: Personal growth: targeted breakthrough of bottlenecks
map.系统汇总各型得分: System summarizes scores of all types
map.看最高分类型及其释义: View the highest-scoring type and its interpretation
map.结合侧翼理解更立体: Combine with wings for a fuller understanding
map.按最像我而非我想成为答: Answer by what is most like me, not who I want to be
map.九型看动机而非行为表象: Enneagram looks at motivation, not behavioral surface
map.高分型可能有 2~3 个接近，看整体: Several high types may be close (2-3); look at the whole
map.用于成长而非贴标签评判: For growth, not for labeling judgment
map.九型和 MBTI 有什么区别？: What is the difference between Enneagram and MBTI?
map.九型聚焦核心动机与恐惧，MBTI 偏认知偏好，角度不同可互补。: Enneagram focuses on core motivation and fear; MBTI leans toward cognitive preference; different angles can complement each other.
map.为什么我好几型都高？: Why are several of my types high?
map.很多人有相邻侧翼，核心型看最高且最贴合内心的那一个。: Many people have adjacent wings; the core type is the highest and most inwardly fitting one.
